mapper.insert: INSERT INTO bills ( user_id, category_id, transaction_type, amount, transaction_date, remark, mood ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{categoryId}, #{transactionType}, #{amount}, #{transactionDate}, #{remark}, #{mood} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, user_id, category_id, transaction_type, amount, transaction_date, remark, mood, created_at, updated_at FROM bills WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId}

SELECT b.id, b.transaction_type, b.category_id, c.name AS category_name, b.amount, b.transaction_date, b.remark, b.mood, b.created_at, b.updated_at FROM bills b INNER JOIN categories c ON c.id = b.category_id WHERE b.id = #{id} AND b.user_id = #{userId}
